objective: Explain how frontend, backend, and database work together.
hook: A website is more than the screen you see!
narration: A website is more than the screen you see! Meet Pixel, who builds the frontend: buttons, colors, and pages people use. Byte handles the backend, where code receives requests and applies the rules. Their library, Data Dock, stores details such as names and scores. When you tap Login, the frontend asks the backend, the backend checks the database, then sends an answer back. A full-stack developer understands how all three parts connect. Follow Amala Code Quest for the next lesson!
